messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with a pale pink, deeply wrinkled, smooth-skinned body and broad rounded head, four short stout legs with clawed toes, and a long trunk whose back and upper sides are covered in overlapping dark brown armor scales. Behind the head fan pink stalks with dense red feathery filaments. The head has large round dark eyes, tiny nostrils and a slight upturned mouth. The rear of the body continues to the left out of frame.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "pale pink smooth rounded salamander-like head with slight smile and small nostrils", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right end of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round black protruding eyes with pale bluish-white rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink stalks with dense red feathery filaments, three on each side", "part": "gills", "where": "fanning outward from behind the head"}, {"looks_like": "short thick pale pink wrinkled limbs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two behind"}, {"looks_like": "broad pink feet with five short toes tipped with small pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping dark brown rounded armor scales with lighter brown edges", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the back and upper sides from behind the head to the left edge"}, {"looks_like": "pale pink hairless skin with deep transverse wrinkles and folds", "part": "skin", "where": "on the head, underside, sides and legs where not covered by scales"}, {"looks_like": "thick continuation of the scaly top and pink wrinkled underside", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear left extending out of frame"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
